baseline_definition: Approve purchase if Purchase <= Current Balance (Conventional Balance/Budget Interface)
spendable_definition: Approve purchase if Purchase <= Safe Spendable Capacity (Spendable Intelligence Engine)

liquidity_failure_rate.definition: Percentage of simulated purchase decisions that result in post-purchase minimum balance dropping below safety reserve buffer.
liquidity_failure_rate.baseline_rule: Approve purchase if Purchase <= Current Balance
liquidity_failure_rate.spendable_rule: Approve purchase if Purchase <= Spendable Capacity

overspending_incident_rate.definition: Percentage of simulated purchase decisions that result in account overdraft (< ৳0.0 balance).
overspending_incident_rate.baseline_rule: Approve purchase if Purchase <= Current Balance
overspending_incident_rate.spendable_rule: Approve purchase if Purchase <= Spendable Capacity

missed_payment_rate.definition: Percentage of purchase decisions that leave insufficient balance to cover detected upcoming recurring commitments.
missed_payment_rate.baseline_rule: Approve purchase if Purchase <= Current Balance
missed_payment_rate.spendable_rule: Approve purchase if Purchase <= Spendable Capacity

decision_time_framework.reason: No real human user study, eye-tracking, or click-stream timing data exists in repository.

statistical_notes: Evaluated across 14,841 simulated purchase decisions across 1,649 held-out test snapshots.
95% bootstrap confidence intervals derived from 1000 resamples.
Spendable reduced projected liquidity failure rate from 19.49% down to 2.37% (absolute reduction: 17.12 percentage points, relative reduction: 87.86%).
Overdraft incident rate dropped from 8.64% (Baseline) down to 0.88% (Spendable).
Variant E produced 100% identical financial decision outcomes to Variant D, proving Gemini serves as a context-grounded explanation layer without altering financial calculations.
limitations: Evaluated on synthetic account trajectory datasets (data/ground_truth.json). Does not claim real-world customer adoption or live behavioral compliance.
Customer Decision Time is explicitly marked NOT YET MEASURED as no human eye-tracking or A/B click-stream timing data exists in the repository.
Backend model inference latency (9.68ms) is NOT used as a proxy for human decision-making speed.
